[[House of Organa/Legends|House Organa]] had a '''medical camp''' located in the [[Juran Mountains/Legends|Juran Mountains]] on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. Around [[3643 BBY]] [[Grand Marshal/Legends|Grand Marshal]] [[An'bal]] was killed defending this camp.
